title: Blackbaud SKY API
description: Blackbaud SKY API (Raiser's Edge NXT) dual-credential authentication: an OAuth2 authorization-code-flow confidential-application token pair PLUS a separate, always-required SKY API subscription key header. Both parts are independently required on every call -- missing either returns 401.

ClientID.title: Client ID
ClientID.description: OAuth2 confidential-application Client ID, issued when the application is registered at developer.sky.blackbaud.com.

ClientSecret.title: Client Secret
ClientSecret.description: OAuth2 confidential-application Client Secret. Required to exchange an authorization code (or refresh token) for an access token, and required for the API to ever return a refresh_token in the token response.

AuthorizationURL.title: Authorization URL
AuthorizationURL.description: OAuth2 authorization-code endpoint. Confirmed identical across all in-scope SKY API OpenAPI specs' securityDefinitions.skyApiOAuth.

TokenURL.title: Token URL
TokenURL.description: OAuth2 token endpoint, used both for the initial authorization-code exchange and for subsequent refresh_token exchanges.

RefreshToken.title: Refresh Token
RefreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token obtained from the initial authorization-code exchange (only issued when ClientSecret is present, i.e. confidential/server-side app flow). Uses a sliding 365-day expiration by default -- Blackbaud issues a NEW refresh_token on every refresh unless the token request sets preserve_refresh_token=true.

AccessToken.title: Access Token
AccessToken.description: OAuth2 access token for temporary direct access (short-lived -- expires after 60 minutes per the vendor's own tutorial sample, expires_in: 3599). Not recommended for production; prefer RefreshToken so the connector can mint new access tokens automatically.

SubscriptionKey.title: SKY API Subscription Key
SubscriptionKey.description: Static per-app SKY API subscription key (primary or secondary, both equally functional), obtained from the developer's My Subscriptions page after subscribing to a SKY API product tier. Sent on EVERY request as the 'bb-api-subscription-key' header -- this is a SECOND, independent credential part alongside the OAuth2 bearer token, not a substitute for it. Missing this header returns 401 even with a valid access token.
